name: Gift Wrap Swap
raw: Gift Wrap Swap | 11:00 AM Saturday, November 21, 2026 - 1:00 PM Saturday, November 21, 2026 | Hammond Room | Adult, Family | Freshen up your presents this holiday season, or just put unused gift-wrapping supplies into the hands of someone who will use them! Get an early access ticket by dropping off your donations at the Reference Desk between November 15-20; with the ticket, you can shop 10:00-11:00 a.m. All are invited

name: Glencoe's Annual Light the Lights Festival
raw: Glencoe's Annual Light the Lights Festival | 5:00 PM Friday, November 27, 2026 - 7:00 PM Friday, November 27, 2026 | Hammond Room, Johnson Room | Family, Children | Head downtown the day after Thanksgiving and join in the fun! The library will be open 5-7 p.m. for a festive children's craft in the Johnson Room and a sensory (low-stimulus) room in the Hammond Room for anyone who wants a quieter space. Many thanks to the Glencoe Council for Inclusion and Communit
notes: Library open 5-7 PM with kids craft and sensory room; village festival downtown (Wyman Green lighting, Santa and live reindeer in Winter Village, Frozen/Bluey characters, trackless train, hot chocolate). Some festival extras may cost money.
